insecure.description: Whether to verify the server's SSL certificate

connection_params.description: Datastore parameters. Match the parameters as defined in the REST API.

default.description: Mark the datastore as default. Default value is false.

description.description: Description of the datastore. Default value is empty.

enabled.description: Mark the datastore as enabled. Default value is true.

name.description: Name of the datastore. Used to compute the id of the resource.

workspace_name.description: Name of the workspace owning the datastore. Used to compute the id of the resource.

access_type.description: Access type to the bucket. Could be PUBLIC or PRIVATE. Default is PUBLIC

blobstore_id.description: Identifier of the blobstore. Use as resource id.

bucket_secret_key.description: Secret key associated to the access key.

default.description: Is the blobstore the default one? Default to false.

enabled.description: Is the blobstore enabled? Default to true.

endpoint.description: End-point to use to access the bucket, when not using AWS S3

max_connections.description: Maximum number of parallel connections. Default to 50.

prefix.description: Prefix to add to the path for storing the tiles. Default is empty

use_gzip.description: Compress tiles with gzip. Default to false.

use_https.description: Use https to contact the S3 bucket. Default to false.

cache_cleanup_frequency.description: Duration to wait between each cleanup execution. Unit depends on cache_cleanup_units

cache_cleanup_units.description: Time unit used to express cleanup frequency. Authorized values are : SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS, DAYS

enabled.description: Is the disk quota mechanism enabled? Default is false.

global_expiration_policy_name.description: Policy to use when tiles have to be removed. Authorized values are : LRU, LFU

global_quota_units.description: The type of unit quantified by value. Authorized values are : B, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB

maximum_concurrent_cleanup.description: The amount of threads to use when processing the disk quota

expiration_policy_name.description: Policy to use when tiles have to be removed. Authorized values are : LRU, LFU

quota_units.description: The type of unit quantified by value. Authorized values are : B, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB

block.description: The disk quota to apply for a given layer.

Manage GeoWebCache Disk Quota Policy. The policy is a singleton so Create is similar to Update and Delete has no effect. There is a bug on the GWC REST API which prevents reading the existing configuration

base_directory.description: Base directory to store the tiles.

blobstore_id.description: Identifier of the blobstore. Use as resource id.

enabled.description: Is the blobstore enabled? Default to true.

align_top_left.description: Is the top left corner aligned? Default to true.

name.description: Name of the gridset. Use as resource id.

y_coordinate_first.description: Does the Y coordinate come first? Default to true.

allow_cache_bypass.description: Allow bypass of the cache. Default to false.

backend_timeout.description: Timeout of the backend. Default to 120.

blobstore_id.description: Blobstore to use for storing the tiles.

enabled.description: Is the layer cache enabled? Default to true.

expire_duration_cache.description: Server cache expire duration. Default to 0.

expire_duration_clients.description: Client cache expire duration. Default to 0.

gutter_size.description: Size of the gutter to use for the meta-tiles. Default to 0.

mime_formats.description: List of the mime formats upported for this cache.

name.description: Name of the cache layer. Use as resource id.

transparent.description: Request tiles with transparent background? Default to true.

vendor_parameters.description: Additional vendor parameters to the service.

wms_layer.description: Identifier of the layer to cache.

wms_url.description: URL of the server hosting the WMS.

wms_version.description: WMS version to use when requesting service. Default to 1.3.0

block.description: List of the grids supported for this cache.

path.description: Path of the resource in the GeoServer data_dir.

access_constraints.description: Specific access constraints of the service

interpolation.description: Interpolation strategy. Authorized values are : Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic

is_dynamic_styling_disabled.description: status of dynamic styling (SLD and SLD_BODY params) allowance

is_getfeatureinfo_mimetype_checking_enab.description: Flag indicating if getFeatureInfo MIME type checking is enabled

is_getmap_mimetype_checking_enabled.description: Flag indicating if getMap MIME type checking is enabled.

is_verbose.description: Flag indicating if the service should be verbose or not

maximum_rendering_errors.description: Max number of rendering errors that will be tolerated before stating the rendering operation failed by throwing a service exception back to the client

maximum_rendering_time.description: Max time, in seconds, a WMS request is allowed to spend rendering the map. Various output formats will do a best effort to respect it (raster formats, for example, will account just rendering time, but not image encoding time).

maximum_request_memory.description: Max amount of memory, in kilobytes, that each WMS request can allocate (each output format will make a best effort attempt to respect it, but there are no guarantees). 0 indicates no limit.

online_resource.description: Additional online resources about the service

schema_base_url.description: The base url for the schemas describing the service.

supported_versions.description: The versions of the service that are available.

use_bbox_foreach_crs.description: Flag indicating if watermarking is enabled

watermark_enabled.description: Flag indicating if watermarking is enabled

watermark_position.description: Position of the watermark. Authorized values are : TOP_LEFT, TOP_CENTER, TOP_RIGHT, MID_LEFT, MID_CENTER, MID_RIGHT, BOT_LEFT, BOT_CENTER, BOT_RIGHT

watermark_transparency.description: The transparency of the watermark logo, ranging from 0 to 255

workspace_name.description: Name of the workspace owning the style. Used to compute the id of the resource.

filename.description: Name of the file describing the style.

format.description: Format of the style. Must match one of the style format installed on your geoserver instance.
